About The Job

zerohash's Applied AI team manages two fronts: an internal Intelligence Core (a system connectivity and control layer) and external agentic-commerce products. This role acts as the engineering backbone for both—building the access layer, audit logging, skills/agents, and system architecture. The Applied AI team builds the Intelligence Core itself. Engineering maintains platform accounts, event hooks, and retrieval layers; this role builds everything above them.

Core objective:
Connect company systems securely, and produce records of agent action that a third party can verify.

Strategic importance:
The internal build acts as a sandbox for agentic commerce products. Identity, authority, write permissions, and tamper-evident logging will be proven internally before powering multi-institutional agentic networks.

Responsibilities

Own the access layer (native connectors, MCP servers, Databricks US/EU) using short-lived tokens, least-privilege read-only access, and zero raw PII while enforcing data residency.
Define a versioned schema for two signed record types of credentials and action records, in one namespace so each can be checked against the other.
Establish build discipline early: deployment pipelines, authority policy as code, skill merge gates, and signed builds with SBOMs.
Build the authority lease service with integrated kill switches.
Capture events into append-only, hash-chained logs for tamper-evident and independently verifiable auditing.
Migrate the team’s existing agents onto the Core, launch new per-department agents and lead security reviews for continuous read access.
Extend the Core from read to bounded write: logged actions, idempotency keys, compensating actions, and multi-approver time-locks for anything that moves money.
Design core primitives for cross-institution interoperability, wrapping actions in signed mandates, scoped authority, and attestation receipts compatible with standards like x402, AP2, and MPP.
Design self-hosted, zero-egress private stacks when required by classification evidence.
Evaluate and integrate state-of-the-art developments in agent frameworks, confidential inference, and zero-knowledge attestations.
Maintain a security-first posture by threat-modeling prompt injection, credential exfiltration, and confused-deputy risks upfront.

Requirements

Senior, Python-first backend engineering with production experience in event-driven systems, API integration, and CI/CD.
Agent-system experience — composing LLM agents (Claude, GPT, or comparable; Bedrock or comparable platforms) into standing systems — with the judgment to keep the models at the edges and the control plane deterministic.
Demonstrate security-first habits in a regulated environment (MSB/VASP, bank, or comparable): least privilege and read-only as reflexes, not requirements to be reminded of.
Working familiarity with capability-based authorization: attenuable tokens, workload identity, policy-as-code.

Preferred

Verifiable credentials, HTTP message signatures, or any of the emerging agent-payment mandate schemes (x402, AP2, MPP, Visa TAP, Mastercard Agent Pay).
Self-hosted LLM stacks; confidential computing / trusted execution environments.
A research habit and autonomy: this is a foundational seat on a new team, with wide scope and few hand-holds.

Benefits

Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
Chance to earn equity
Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
WeWork All Access Membership
WFH Yearly Stipend
L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About Zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and make a difference every day.
Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.

Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

Data Scientist

The Opportunity:

As a data scientist, you’re excited at the prospect of unlocking the secrets held by a data set, and you’re fascinated by the possibilities presented by IoT, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. Work with us as we use data science for good.

new_jobs.title: Principal, AI & Technology Value Creation
new_jobs.description:
Mongoose is TriEdge Investments’ technology and AI value creation team, working across a portfolio of more than 30 operating companies, primarily in healthcare, with growing work in financial services and other operationally complex industries.

We work directly with management teams to understand their businesses, identify opportunities where technology can improve performance, and build solutions that deliver measurable results. Our model combines the rigor of consulting, the perspective of an investor, and the ability to build and deploy technology ourselves.

The Role

We are looking for a senior leader to work directly with executives and operating teams to shape how AI and technology can improve their businesses and identify the opportunities with the greatest potential for value creation.

You will typically be one of the first people from Mongoose to engage with a new portfolio company or client. You will get inside the business, working with executives and frontline teams to understand how it actually operates: how work gets done, where decisions are made, how data moves through the organization, where processes break down, and where technology can materially improve performance.

You will develop a point of view on where AI and technology can have the greatest impact, translate that into a prioritized set of opportunities, and build the business case for pursuing them. This includes evaluating not only the potential value, but also the feasibility, organizational readiness, and ability to execute.

You will also serve as a senior technology and AI advisor to our management teams, helping them understand how new capabilities can be applied practically across their organizations.

What You’ll Do

Lead discovery and opportunity assessment with new portfolio companies and clients, developing a clear point of view on where AI and technology can create the most value.
Work across the organization, from senior executives to frontline operators, to understand workflows, systems, data, decision points, and areas of operational complexity.
Identify opportunities to use AI, automation, data, and software to improve revenue, margins, productivity, and growth.
Assess and prioritize opportunities based on financial impact, feasibility, organizational readiness, and time to value.
Develop business cases and financial models that clearly articulate expected investment and return.
Present findings and recommendations to CEOs, CFOs, COOs, and other senior leaders.
Advise management teams on AI strategy and the practical adoption of emerging capabilities, including tools such as ChatGPT and Claude as well as more advanced automation and agentic solutions.
Stay current on developments in AI and enterprise technology and apply that knowledge to the operating challenges we see across our companies.
Transition validated opportunities to Mongoose’s product and engineering teams and maintain alignment around the original business objectives and expected value.
Apply lessons and patterns from individual engagements across the broader portfolio.

About You

You have spent your career solving complex business problems at the intersection of operations, technology, and economics. You can walk into an unfamiliar business, understand it quickly, earn the confidence of its leadership team, and develop a clear point of view on where technology can create meaningful value.

15+ years of experience in management consulting, private equity value creation, technology strategy, digital transformation, or a senior operating role.
Significant experience working directly with senior executives on business, operational, and technology priorities.
Strong understanding of how businesses operate, with the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar processes, systems, and economics.
Demonstrated experience identifying, sizing, and prioritizing opportunities using sound financial and operational analysis.
Strong financial acumen, including experience developing business cases and modeling ROI.
Deep understanding of AI, automation, and modern enterprise technology, along with a strong interest in how rapidly evolving capabilities can be applied in practice.
The ability to move comfortably between business and technology discussions and communicate effectively with both operating executives and technical teams.
Strong executive presence, judgment, and communication skills.
Experience in healthcare or another operationally complex industry is strongly preferred.

Why Mongoose

Mongoose offers an unusual opportunity to work across a diverse group of operating companies and help senior management teams determine where AI and technology can create meaningful business value.

The work does not end with a recommendation. When we identify an opportunity worth pursuing, we have the capability to build it, deploy it, and measure the results.

Each engagement also informs the next. Working across a portfolio allows us to recognize patterns, apply lessons across companies, and build a deeper understanding of where AI can change how businesses operate.

That combination, working directly with management, identifying the opportunity, and seeing the resulting technology put into operation—is what makes the role different.

Location

TriEdge Investments is headquartered in New York's Hudson Yards. We've designed our workplace to foster the collaboration and spontaneous interactions that drive innovation. Our team works in-office, with flexibility to work remotely when needed.

What we offer

Pay Transparency

The annual base salary range for this position is $300,000 – $350,000
. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted hiring range based on experience and skill level, among other factors. This role is also eligible for a discretionary fund performance bonus.

Benefits

$0 deductible and 100% employee-covered health, vision, and dental insurance
401(k) matching program of 50% up to 6% of annual salary
Unlimited PTO
Beautiful custom-built office in NYC with daily lunch

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Developer Tools
new_jobs.description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker is looking for a Senior Software Engineer
to build AI-powered developer tools and the platform behind them on our AI Developer Tools team. You will work at the intersection of AI, developer experience, and platform engineering, building tools that make Docker's engineers more productive and the platform that lets teams across Docker prototype, deploy, and scale their own AI developer tools.

As a Senior Engineer you will design, build, and operate:

AI-Powered Developer Tools.
AI agents and tools that accelerate developer productivity, surface observability insights, and automate operational reviews. You will help teams adopt an AI-native way of working and speed up adoption of tools such as Claude Code and Codex. Examples include AI-powered code review and refactoring assistants, automated test generators and local environment setup tools, deployment pipeline diagnostic agents, and agents that simplify on-call work during incidents.

Self-Service AI Developer Tools Platform.
Platform infrastructure that lets product and platform teams across Docker unblock themselves by prototyping, building, and deploying their own AI developer tools, using the patterns and standards the team sets.

You will report to the Senior Manager, AI Developer Tools, and work closely with the team's Principal and Staff engineers, product engineering teams, and platform teams across Docker.

What Would Make Someone Successful in This Role

You are a strong, hands-on engineer who enjoys building at the intersection of AI, developer experience, and platform engineering. You have built software on top of LLMs and AI agents and have a good sense of what works in practice. You care about the people using your tools, and you can tell a tool developers love from one they put up with. You take a feature from a vague request to production: you ask the right questions about requirements, design it sensibly, ship it iteratively, and operate it afterward. You are comfortable in a fast-moving AI landscape and balance quality with pragmatism. You make the engineers around you better through thoughtful code review and by sharing what you learn.

Responsibilities

Building and Operating AI Developer Tools

Design, build, and operate production AI agents for developer productivity, including code review assistants, test generators, deployment diagnostics, and incident response automation
Integrate LLM providers, agent orchestration frameworks, and MCP servers into reliable tools, following the team's patterns and standards
Build systems that help Docker's engineers adopt AI-native development tools
Build integrations between AI developer tools and existing developer infrastructure such as CI/CD pipelines, observability platforms, and deployment systems
Instrument your tools so the team can measure adoption, effectiveness, and developer satisfaction

Self-Service Platform

Build and improve platform capabilities, including deployment pipelines (ArgoCD/GitOps), observability integration (Grafana), security controls, and cost management, that help teams ship their own AI tools faster
Help reduce time-to-production for new products from weeks to days
Contribute to reliability, security, and performance standards for AI systems, including SLOs, monitoring, and incident response

Design and Delivery

Take features and services from requirements to production. Ask about scale, users, and constraints before designing, and write down your assumptions
Write clear design documents for the work you own, and participate in design reviews for the team
Review code thoroughly and share what you learn with the rest of the team
Take part in the team's on-call rotation, and help improve alerts, runbooks, and tooling so the next incident is easier
Follow the AI-assisted engineering practices the team sets: use AI tools critically, validate their output, and stay accountable for what you ship

Collaboration and Growth

Work with the Senior Manager and the team's Principal and Staff engineers to understand priorities and shape your work
Partner with Infrastructure, Security, and Data teams on integrations and shared standards
Help newer engineers get up to speed on the team's tools, patterns, and practices
Keep up with emerging AI/LLM technologies and agent frameworks, and bring useful findings back to the team

Qualifications

Required

6+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, AI agents, or AI-assisted developer tools
Working knowledge of LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, and others), prompt engineering, agent orchestration frameworks, and practical uses of AI in software development workflows
Experience building and operating scalable backend services, distributed systems, or developer-facing platforms
Experience with cloud-native infrastructure, including Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and observability systems
Proficiency in Go (preferred), Rust, Java, or Python, with strong software engineering fundamentals
Experience building developer tools, platform systems, or internal tools that other engineers rely on
Good product judgment: you weigh developer experience and technical trade-offs, and you ask clarifying questions before committing to a design
Clear written and spoken communication suited to a remote, async-first company
Ownership mentality with a bias for action and iterative delivery in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
Comfortable working autonomously in a distributed, remote-first team
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred

Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar AI agent integration standards
Background in developer productivity, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering
Contributions to open source AI tools, developer tooling, or platform engineering projects
Experience with GitOps deployment patterns (ArgoCD) or Grafana-based observability
Familiarity with security and operational practices for production AI systems
Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

What to Expect

First 30 Days

Learn Docker's current AI and developer tooling landscape, the team's services, and the architecture decisions made so far
Meet your teammates, including the Principal and Staff engineers, the Senior Manager, and key stakeholders in product engineering
Ship a useful production change in your first weeks, using the team's AI-assisted engineering workflow
Review existing AI tool prototypes and internal experiments to learn what is working and what is not
Shadow on-call and learn the operational profile of the team's services

First 90 Days

Own a feature or service from design to production with measurable impact, such as part of an AI code review agent, a deployment diagnostic agent, or an on-call assistant
Write the design document for work you own and take part in team design reviews
Contribute to the self-service platform's deployment pipeline, observability integration, or security controls
Take part in the on-call rotation

First Year Outlook

Be a go-to engineer for one or more of the team's AI tools or platform components
Have shipped multiple production improvements that Docker engineers use every day, with adoption and effectiveness you can point to
Have helped teams outside AI Developer Tools build and run their own tools on the platform
Have taken on larger and more ambiguous work as your scope grows, and helped newer engineers do the same

Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs.

Compensation & Equity

United States:
$160,900 – $260,700 + equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.
AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.
Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.
Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.
Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.
Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.
Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.
Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.
Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.
Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.
Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.
Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

Compensation Range: $160.9K - $260.7K

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the Role
:

As a Senior AI Agent Engineer | Federal
at Moveworks by ServiceNow, you'll be responsible for making our strategic public sector customers successful with the Moveworks platform by accelerating product adoption and innovation across federal civilian, defense, and intelligence community engagements. You are a critical, high-leverage technical individual that operates at the intersection of Customer Success, Product Management, and Engineering — with a deep appreciation for working hands-on with products, technical problem-solving, and architecting solutions.

Your primary mission is to translate complex business challenges into innovative, high-impact AI solutions built on our platform. This role provides full-stack ownership of technical success, allowing you to not only deploy capabilities within our offering but also directly influence the product's evolution by ensuring that learnings are folded back into our core platform and roadmap.

Core Responsibilities & Impact

Full-stack Ownership: Partner deeply with federal customers throughout the entire delivery lifecycle of AI Agents on the Moveworks platform: Vision-Lock, Solution Design/Architecture, Building, Tuning, and launch — while navigating the realities of federal procurement, ATO timelines, and agency governance.
Custom Solution Design: Architect, design, and consult with federal stakeholders to develop high-impact AI solutions that leverage AI in novel and meaningful ways to solve mission-critical business challenges.
Integration and Implementation: Integrate the Moveworks by ServiceNow Platform with enterprise systems (ITSM, HRIS, identity, knowledge sources) in a manner that is innovative, performant, and compliant with federal security and data-handling requirements, including deployments in FedRAMP High and IL4/IL5 environments where applicable.
Product Partnership: Work closely with engineering and product teams on new product rollouts, and help drive product decision-making by synthesizing on-the-ground customer feedback, compliance requirements, and technical gaps unique to the public sector.
Strategic Guidance & Influence: Serve as a trusted advisor to federal customers, providing strategic direction to help them overcome technical, organizational, and compliance obstacles, including upskilling agency teams to operate the product independently.
Reusability & Knowledge Sharing: Generalize successful customer solutions into reusable templates and share learnings broadly across the team.

You are a technical generalist who genuinely enjoys working directly with customers. You thrive at the intersection of engineering, consulting, and customer success — and you're equally energized by solving a complex integration problem and presenting a solution narrative to a customer's executive team.

Communication: You can build deep partnerships across technical staff, program managers, and executives — and translate solutions into clear artifacts (architecture diagrams, proposals, ATO artifacts, SOWs) and compelling narratives for any audience.

ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

The Role

We are seeking a highly technical and partner-focused Solutions Architect
to join AMD's Global Partner Team, with dedicated focus on our strategic Global Systems Integrator (GSI) partners. This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor to GSIs, helping shape technical strategy, develop repeatable AMD-based solutions and offerings, and accelerate adoption of AMD technologies across enterprise customers and industry use cases.

Working closely with GSI architects, developers, practices, Centers of Excellence (CoEs), and business leaders, this individual will help partners design and bring to market differentiated solutions spanning AI and Generative AI, data center, cloud, client, embedded, HPC, and networking technologies.

This is a highly collaborative and hands-on role requiring a unique combination of deep technical expertise, solution architecture, partner leadership, and business acumen. You will work across GSI and AMD engineering, product, sales, and business teams to turn emerging technologies into scalable partner solutions and compelling customer outcomes.

The Person

Does this sound like you? We'd love to talk!

GSI & Partner Expertise: Strong understanding of how GSIs build practices, Centers of Excellence, solutions and offerings, enable technical teams, and bring capabilities to market with enterprise customers.
Deep Technical Expertise: Strong technical foundation across enterprise architecture, software and hardware platforms, AI, data center, cloud, and modern application environments, with the ability and willingness to work hands-on.
Solution Architecture & Innovation: Ability to translate complex technologies and customer requirements into scalable architectures, proofs of concept/value, and repeatable partner solutions.
Technical Influence & Executive Presence: Comfortable engaging audiences ranging from developers and architects to senior technical and business executives, translating complex technical capabilities into meaningful business value.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to influence and mobilize teams across partner organizations, engineering, product, sales, and business functions without direct authority.
Curiosity & Hands-On Mindset: Self-directed learner who is comfortable entering unfamiliar technical territory, solving complex problems, and operating as both a strategic advisor and a doer.

Key Responsibilities

Drive strategic technical alignment with GSI partners, shaping solution strategy and developing repeatable AMD-based offerings and joint innovation initiatives.
Develop GSI-level technical strategies, solution architectures, practices, Centers of Excellence, proofs of concept/value, and scalable offerings built on AMD technologies.
Partner with GSI architects, developers, and technical leaders to accelerate adoption of AMD technologies across partner offerings, platforms, and services.
Work closely with AMD and GSI Solutions Architects, engineering, product, sales, and business teams to design full-stack solutions for enterprise and industry-specific use cases.
Lead technical enablement through workshops, demonstrations, architecture guidance, proofs of value, and coaching for GSI technical teams.
Participate in joint business planning and executive/business reviews, ensuring alignment between AMD and GSI technical strategies, priorities, and investments.
Analyze GSI practices, services, and offerings and identify opportunities to increase differentiation and customer value through AMD technologies and capabilities.
Serve as a technical advocate for GSI partners within AMD, bringing forward partner use cases, feature requirements, technical challenges, and support needs and helping drive them toward resolution.
Partner with business leaders to develop technical vision and actionable strategies that support joint go-to-market priorities and business growth.
Represent AMD and our GSI partnerships with customers and at partner and industry events, articulating the technical and business value of AMD solutions across AI, data center, cloud, client, embedded, HPC, and networking.

Preferred Experience

Direct experience working at or closely with Global Systems Integrators, with strong understanding of GSI practices, solution development, Centers of Excellence, industry use cases, and go-to-market models.
Strong solution architecture and development experience across AI/ML and Generative AI, data center, cloud, HPC, client, and/or enterprise application environments.
Hands-on understanding of modern software development and DevOps lifecycles, including experience working directly with developers and technical teams.
Experience architecting full-stack infrastructure solutions spanning compute, storage, networking, virtualization, containers, and orchestration.
Experience with technologies and platforms such as Kubernetes, VMware, Nutanix, Red Hat OpenShift, and related enterprise infrastructure environments.
Strong understanding of AI and data ecosystems, ML/DL frameworks, MLOps, and modern AI application development.
Experience developing proofs of concept/value, technical enablement programs, reference architectures, or repeatable partner solutions.
Ability to translate complex technical architectures and capabilities into compelling customer, partner, and business value propositions.
Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging both technical and business audiences.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across highly matrixed global organizations while independently driving initiatives forward.

Academic Credentials

BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, another engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
